description: 2nd connection. 1st connection (2026-09-28T15:39:57Z) was CONFIRMED SUCCESS on every structural question it set out to test: TESTKIT (embedded SQL in a NOMAIN module, SET OPTION placed after the module-level D-specs) compiled and ran; CHGCURLIB1 put TESTRES in &LIB (not <USER>1); the case-00 deliberate failure sent its QMHSNDPM(*ESCAPE) message and the wrapper's own RUNTSTJUCSRV step never logged a FAILED marker afterward (strong evidence MONITOR caught it and TSTJUCSRV's mainline ran to completion rather than aborting); TSTZAISRV's 11 assertions ALL PASSED, including direct confirmation that OVRDBF+OVRSCOPE(*JOB) really redirected ZAISRV's internal ZAIKOM open to the QTEMP copy (TESTRES showed the seeded 7, not the real 45) while the shared-zaikom-check collect confirmed the real &LIB/ZAIKOM stayed at 45 (db/data/load_v1.sql's seed) throughout - untouched, no TXRESET needed. ONE real bug found and fixed (src/qrpglesrc/testkit.sqlrpgle, this connection includes the fix): testInit() used to DELETE FROM TESTRES every call, on the assumption one test-case program calls it once per connection - TSTZAISRV's own testInit() call silently wiped TSTJUCSRV's just-logged 11 rows (00 through 10B) before the collect step could read them, so the 1st connection's TESTRES collect only ever showed TSTZAISRV's rows. testInit() is now create-only (never deletes); this manifest adds its own explicit CLEARTESTRES step (same pattern the CL wrapper already uses for VFYLOG) so THIS connection starts from a clean table and both programs' rows survive together in the final collect. Everything else below is unchanged from the 1st connection (all three objects already compiled with Highest Severity 00; REPLACE(*YES) makes recompiling them here harmless) - this connection's only real purpose is observing TSTJUCSRV's own 13 rows (cases 00-10B) for the first time, now that they will not be overwritten.

steps.label: CPTESTKITM
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/TESTKIT) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TESTKIT) OBJTYPE(*MODULE) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: CPTESTKITS
steps.cmd: CRTSRVPGM SRVPGM(&LIB/TESTKIT) MODULE(&LIB/TESTKIT) EXPORT(*SRCFILE) SRCFILE(&LIB/QSRVSRC) SRCMBR(TESTKIT) ACTGRP(*CALLER) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTESTKITBD
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/TESTKITBD) OBJTYPE(*BNDDIR)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTBNDDIR BNDDIR(&LIB/TESTKITBD))
ADDBNDDIRE BNDDIR(&LIB/TESTKITBD) OBJ((*LIBL/TESTKIT *SRVPGM))

steps.label: CPTSTJUCSRV
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTJUCSRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTJUCSRV) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/JUCSRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: CPTSTZAISRV
steps.cmd: CRTBNDRPG PGM(&LIB/TSTZAISRV) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(TSTZAISRV) DFTACTGRP(*NO) ACTGRP(*NEW) BNDDIR((*LIBL/ZAISRVBD) (*LIBL/TESTKITBD)) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.label: QTEMPZAIKOM
steps.cmd: CRTDUPOBJ OBJ(ZAIKOM) FROMLIB(&LIB) OBJTYPE(*FILE) TOLIB(QTEMP) DATA(*YES)

steps.label: SEEDQTEMP
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('UPDATE QTEMP/ZAIKOM SET ZASU = 7 WHERE ZASHO = ''P00001''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.sql: SELECT SEQ, TESTNM, EXPECTED, ACTUAL, RESULT FROM &LIB/TESTRES ORDER BY SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN RESULT = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PASS_CNT FROM &LIB/TESTRES
SELECT ZASHO, ZASU FROM &LIB/ZAIKOM WHERE ZASHO = 'P00001'
